dr-egeria.description: Dr. Egeria MCP server (egeria-workspaces-fs PyegeriaWebHandler/mcp_server.py) - dr_egeria_run_block, egeria_execute_command, egeria_list_commands, egeria_refresh_specs, egeria_list_glossaries, egeria_list_collections, plus report tools (overridden by the pyegeria server, which connects last). NOT the same server as pyegeria.core.mcp_server: that one exposes report tools only, which is what egeria-advisor CLAUDE.md rule 24 is about. This one still exposes the full Dr.Egeria command surface. command/args and EGERIA_ROOT_PATH are host-specific - point them at a real egeria-workspaces-fs checkout, or leave the placeholders and set enabled=false if you have none.

pyegeria.description: PyEgeria MCP server — report discovery and execution (list_reports, find_report_specs, run_report, describe_report). Connects last so its tool definitions win over dr-egeria's for shared tool names. The command/args and PYEGERIA_USER_REPORT_SPECS_DIR here are only the last-resort fallback — advisor.mcp_config.resolve_pyegeria_mcp_command()/resolve_report_specs_dir() (see advisor/mcp_agent.py::_resolve_server_command/_resolve_server_env) resolve the actual interpreter and an absolute report-specs path at load time, so this file never needs host-specific edits for a normal checkout.

_example_remote_sse.description: Example remote Egeria MCP server via SSE transport. Set enabled=true and fill in url/headers to use a non-local Egeria instance.
